Account Resets

Updated this week

Most traders don't pass the evaluation the first time. If you fail a rule, you can reset your evaluation for a fee and try again. This resets the days traded, the balance, and rules by creating a new evaluation account.
​
If your evaluation's subscription renews and your account is already failed, your account will be reset for free within an hour after the renewal payment completes.
​

Sometimes, you may have to ask Support to reset the account once rebilled.

​
BluLive/Buffer Accounts

A failed BluLive/Buffer account can be reset as many times as you need.

 

Your first three resets are $250 each. The price then rises by $50 for every further three resets — $300 for resets 4–6, $350 for resets 7–9, $400 for 10–12, and so on.
​

(Note: If the BluLive Account was passed and moved to Sim Funded, the Reset Fee will be $500 for all resets)
